defs.def: a strong wish to have or do sth 愿望；欲望；渴望

ex.s: Although she’d had childhood _____41_____ of exploring the world and studied international business with a desire to pursue a _____42_____ in Toronto, finding a job proved more _____43_____ than she’d expected.
ex.t: 尽管她童年时曾_____41_____探索世界，并怀着在 Toronto 追求_____42_____事业的渴望学习了国际商务，但找工作比她预期的更_____43_____。

ex.s: Your audience will naturally be more interested and engaged when you tailor your communications to their interests. ___37___ This will engage their desire to understand and interact with the information.
ex.t: 当您根据听众的兴趣调整沟通方式时，他们自然会更有兴趣和参与感。___37___ 这将激发他们理解和互动信息的愿望。

ex.s: her own understanding of successB. her desire for academic challenges
ex.t: 她自己对成功的理解 B. 她对学术挑战的渴望

ex.s: From the first explorers to today's travelers, humans have always had a desire _________ new places.
ex.t: 从最早的探险家到今天的旅行者，人类一直有_____新地方的渴望。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和渴望可以鼓励我去冒险和做实验。

ex.s: By my fourth year, my desperation to succeed overshadowed my desire for independence.
ex.t: 到第四年，我对成功的极度渴望盖过了我对独立的渴望。

ex.s: The Socrates Express is a fun, sharp book that draws readers in with its apparent simplicity and gradually pulls them in deeper thoughts on desire, loneliness, and aging.
ex.t: 《苏格拉底快线》是一本有趣而犀利的书，以其表面的简单吸引读者，并逐渐将他们拉入关于欲望、孤独和衰老的更深思考。

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全做出改变，但你可以对自己个人空间有一定控制权，来做出你想要的改变。

ex.s: Tightly holding the permission slip from the orchestra director, I ran all the way home after school, and shakily handed it to my parents with a fear that they might dismiss my desire.
ex.t: 紧紧握着管弦乐队指挥的许可条，放学后我一路跑回家，颤抖着把它递给父母，担心他们会拒绝我的愿望。

ex.s: Her strong desire for success.
ex.t: 她对成功的强烈渴望。

ex.s: Instead, all that matters is next quarter’s profit, or satisfying some other near-term desires.
ex.t: 相反，重要的只是下个季度的利润，或满足其他近期欲望。

ex.s: D Bias towards the present helps reduce near-term desires.
ex.t: D 偏向当下的偏见有助于减少近期欲望。

ex.s: The word "wanderlust" in paragraph 2 means a desire to _________?
ex.t: 第2段中的'wanderlust'一词意思是对_________的渴望？

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还帮助唤起一种想在世界有所作为的内在渴望。

ex.s: Her desire to be perfect.
ex.t: 她对完美的渴望。

ex.s: She learned about the harm of desire.
ex.t: 她了解到欲望的危害。

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他母亲以及他想给孩子们更好的饮品选择的渴望中，他想出了 Fun Bottle 的最初模型。

ex.s: He showed us that even a single desire, never given up on, can make for a remarkable life.
ex.t: 他向我们表明，即使是一个从未放弃的单一渴望，也能成就非凡的人生。

ex.s: His desire to regain health.
ex.t: 他恢复健康的渴望。

ex.s: Desire to read.
ex.t: 阅读的渴望。

ex.s: And the crowd desires restful average.
ex.t: 人群渴望宁静的平均。

ex.s: Greatness comes from a lasting desire to explore.
ex.t: 伟大源于持久的探索渴望。

ex.s: First, you need to evaluate yourself , your values your strengths, your weaknesses, your achievements, your desires ,etc Only then should your you’re your goals
ex.t: 首先，你需要评估自己，你的价值观、优势、弱点、成就、你的渴望等等，只有那时你才应该设定目标

ex.s: We're taught to read because it's necessary for much of human understanding． Reading is a vital part of my life． Reading satisfies my desire to keep learning． And I've found that the possibilities that lie within books are limitless．
ex.t: 我们被教导阅读，因为这对人类的理解很有必要。阅读是我生命的重要部分。阅读满足我持续学习的渴望。我发现书中蕴含的可能性是无限的。

ex.s: D．her growing desire to know the world around her
ex.t: D．她日益增长的了解周围世界的渴望

ex.s: Success means getting personal desires satisfied
ex.t: 成功意味着个人欲望得到满足

ex.s: Few people I know seem to have much desire or time to cook.
ex.t: 我认识的人中似乎很少有人有太多做饭的欲望或时间。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以如果我们派出一个机器人，只给它'去取咖啡'这一指令，它就会有强烈的欲望来确保成功，比如关闭自己的关闭开关，甚至杀死任何可能干扰它完成任务的人。

ex.s: run out of human controlB. satisfy human’s real desires
ex.t: 脱离人类控制 B. 满足人类真正的欲望

ex.s: But what remains important is that we have an incredible desire to think and create, and that’s the real spirit of invention.
ex.t: 但我们拥有难以置信的思考与创造的渴望，这才是发明真正的精神。

ex.s: Research also suggests that our desire to seek risks can be connected to how much we expect to 8_______________.
ex.t: 研究还表明，我们寻求风险的渴望可能与我们期望获得的多少有关 8_______________。

ex.s: More importantly, I can act on my desire to help others, for example by 5________________.
ex.t: 更重要的是，我可以根据自己帮助他人的渴望采取行动，例如通过 5________________。

ex.s: Dr Hart says: Obsessive online photo editing indicates lack of self-confidence and a desire for attention.
ex.t: Hart 博士说：过度在线修图表明缺乏自信和对关注的渴望。

ex.s: There is greater public interest in old stories and traditions, as well as a desire for high-quality products.
ex.t: 公众对古老故事和传统有更大的兴趣，以及对高质量产品的渴望。

a person or thing that is wished for 想望的人；渴望的事物
to want sth; to wish for sth 渴望；期望；想望

ex.s: *Fill out desired information:location, job type, etc
ex.t: *填写期望的信息：地点、工作类型等

ex.s: When I applied to graduate school, I found three programmes promising to allow me to follow my desired research direction.
ex.t: 当我申请研究生院时，我发现了三个项目，承诺让我追随我期望的研究方向。

ex.s: The GPNP’s main goal is to improve connectivity between separate ___62___ (population)and homes of giant pandas, and ___63___ (eventual)achieve a desired level of population in the wild.
ex.t: GPNP 的主要目标是改善孤立的___62___（population）和大熊猫家园之间的联系，并___63___（eventual）在野外达到期望的种群水平。

ex.s: So she desired to get round the warning, "Why can't I make a healthy candy that's good for my teeth so that my parents can't say no to it?" With that in mind, Moore asked her dad if she could start her own candy company.
ex.t: 于是她渴望避开这个警告：'为什么我不能做一种对牙齿有益的健康糖果，这样我父母就不会拒绝它呢？'带着这个想法，Moore 问她父亲她是否能创办自己的糖果公司。

defs.def: to be sexually attracted to sb 被（某人）吸引；对（某人）产生性欲
